methods.description: Space separated list of lookup methods to use in ascending priority order.

inmail_db.description: Path to the m_inmail database file.

finger_hosts.description: Space separated list of hosts to query via finger.

mail_domain_name.description: Override the system's mail domain name.

muttalias_files.description: Space separated list of filenames in MUTT_DIRECTORY containing mutt aliases.

pine_rc.description: Space separated list of pine configuration files to inspect for addressbooks.

pine_addressbooks.description: Space separated list of pine addressbook files.

wanderlust_addresses.description: Path to WanderLust address book file.

palm_address_database.description: Path to Palm address database file.

gnomecard_files.description: Space separated list of GnomeCard database files.

emacs_cmd.description: Emacs command to use for BBDB module.

ldap_nicks.description: Space separated list of LDAP server nicknames to use.

abook_files.description: Space separated list of abook addressbook files.

passwd_ignore_sys.description: Set to 'true' to ignore UIDs outside the 1000-29999 range in /etc/passwd.

vcf_files.description: Space separated list of VCF files to search.

modules_path.description: Space separated list of directories containing private lbdb modules.

keep_dupes.description: Whether to keep duplicate mail addresses. 'no' or 'yes'.

munge_limitcount.description: Minimum number of times an entry must be seen by m_inmail to survive cleanup.

munge_limitdate.description: Date string for m_inmail entry cleanup (older entries are removed unless seen > limitcount times).

mu_personal.description: If 'true' or 'yes', only find addresses from messages where 'my' email was in an address field (m_mu).

mu_after.description: UNIX timestamp. Only see addresses seen in messages after this time (m_mu).

mu_ignore_missingname.description: If 'true' or 'yes', do not see addresses without a real name (m_mu).
